entities.summary: Shreya Ghoshal (b. 1984-03-12, Durgapur) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Durgapur and India. Known in the fields of india, composers & musicians, asia.
